cause_quote: The first blocked-submit notice returned `undefined` when `block.gate !== this.blockedSubmitGate`, so the explanation disappeared if one preparation check gave way to another.
user_saw: Pressing Enter or clicking Start while a new chat was still loading could leave the draft unsent with no explanation and a Start button that looked enabled.
summary: The fix disables Start during preparation and, after a blocked attempt, shows the current readiness reason until the user can retry.
reasoning: PR #124613 introduced blocked-submit feedback and covered a single preference restore, but its diff tied the notice to the first blocking check from day one. The fix parent still used that same comparison, and PR #127823 separately introduced the exception that kept Start natively enabled when a blocking reason existed. The history explains why feedback could disappear when checks changed, but does not establish why every reported attempt lacked a visible notice.
